name: The Sunken Ward
summary: Flooded dockside slums infested with cutpurses and smugglers.
description: Perched on rotting piers and half-submerged stone foundations, the Sunken Ward smells of brine and gutter-oil. Wooden walkways crisscross tidal mudflats, and lantern smoke hangs thick in the evening fog.
secrets: Submerged drainage tunnels lead directly beneath the Highspire vault. Access is guarded by giant crabs and syndicate lookout boys.

name: Oakhaven Market Square
summary: The bustling economic heartbeat of the city centered around an ancient Iron-Oak.
description: Dozens of colorful silk awnings shelter merchants selling spices, enchanted trinkets, and masterwork steel. Town criers shout imperial decrees while silver-armored guards patrol in orderly pairs.
secrets: A hollow in the ancient Iron-Oak serves as a dead-drop for informants delivering reports to the Whispering Court.

name: The Rusted Anchor Tavern
summary: A salty, weathered watering hole popular with sailors, bounty hunters, and mercenaries.
description: Constructed from the salvaged rib-timbers of a galleon, this dim tavern serves bitter stout and peppery stew. A massive rusted anchor hangs above the hearth, etched with sailor warding runes.
secrets: The taproom cellar houses a false wine barrel hiding a concealed hatch down to the smuggler slipway.

name: The Cinder-Forge District
summary: Industrial quarter echoing with hammer strikes and glowing with coal-fired blast furnaces.
description: Soot stains the stone towers of this bustling guild quarter. Dwarven and human smiths forge armor, siege weapons, and fine gears day and night beneath plumes of sparks.
secrets: The Master Smith is secretly experimenting with celestial silver smuggled past the Guild tax collectors.

name: Highspire Noble Quarter
summary: Pristine white marble estates, manicured gardens, and private magical libraries.
description: Gilded gates and arcane wards insulate the city's aristocracy from the grime of the lower wards. Griffon-riders occasionally take wing from the watch towers above.
secrets: The Highspire family crypt contains a cursed sarcophagus that vibrates whenever the blood moon rises.

name: The Sunken Ward Catacombs
summary: Ancient pre-cataclysm crypts flooded with black water and walking dead.
description: A forgotten labyrinth of vaulted tombs and sacrificial altars beneath the sea level. Green phosphor fungus coats damp skull niches, and the air tastes of sulfur and ancient decay.
secrets: The central sanctum holds an obsidian key that can break any planar binding ritual.
